verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a concrete catalog-publishing path (Store Sync feed specs including Google Product Feed and OpenAI ACP Product Feed, plus partner connectors like Wix/Cymbio/BigCommerce/Shopware) so agents can discover products, and an agent-tools API to create/list products. However, access is form-gated (not self-serve), Store Sync is limited to US physical goods in USD only, and Agent Ready's ACP/UCP checkout paths require a Braintree account rather than being universally available. Missing for 10: self-serve onboarding without a gated approval process, broader catalog scope (digital goods, subscriptions, international), and independent/hands-on confirmation of feed ingestion working end-to-end.
